explanation: Encode the tree with preorder values and explicit null markers separated by spaces. Decode those tokens recursively, rebuilding each root followed by its left and right subtrees. The wire string contains all required structure and values, independent of encoder state.
timeComplexity: O(n²) conservative worst-case serialization bound from recursive string concatenation in a skew tree; O(n) token parsing/decoding for fixed-width values.
spaceComplexity: O(n + h) encoded/token storage and recursion for n nodes and height h, plus the decoded output tree.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Python algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
